name: Songstrike
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area cone
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a single note, you blast forth a cone of sonic energy from your mouth that inflicts 1d4 points of damage per three caster levels (maximum 5d4).
